The Q&A is the place to ask your questions about the game and event rules, awards, drawings, inspection, and get official answers. Anyone can make their own account in the Q&A system to subscribe to questions and be notified when answers are published. To get “asking” permissions with your account (limited to 1 account/team), you have to attach your team’s authorization code to your account. An account isn’t needed to just read and search existing questions/answers.
Please don’t forget to search for your question first.

You may find it’s already been asked and answered (and if it’s already been asked but not answered, you don’t need to ask it again – just follow that question, and you’ll see when the answer’s posted).

Teams are able to select if they are attending a Kickoff between September 24 - November 17, 2026.
Teams attending a Kickoff will have the option to ship their Kit to the chosen Kickoff for no fee or choose to ship to a location for an additional charge. If a team does not check out by the
, their kit ship may have to be changed to be sent to the team directly for additional fees.
Teams who choose not to attend a Kickoff will have to pay an additional fee to ship their kit and are responsible for any customs fees and/or taxes.
Lead Coach 1 or 2 or the Team Admin may select if they are attending a Kickoff during the kickoff selection dates by following these steps:
Click your team from the Team List.
As a reminder, Kit direct shipments do not ship until after Kickoff (there is not a guaranteed delivery date) and the team must be secured in order for items to ship. Once a team checks out via the
Storefront, teams will not be able to edit their Kickoff selection or change their shipping location.
Teams that miss the November 17, 2026 deadline may be able to still select a Kickoff location until December 1st (pending availability) as long as the team has not completed checkout.

Storefront, veteran teams (Lead Coach 1, Lead Coach 2, or Team Admin) will add the registration option containing their preferred kit components to their cart instead of completing a separate opt out.
